messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari@clearmart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request — storefront search & throughput

Hi Mina,

We just signed up and I wanted to see if someone can walk us through Redwood's inference for our storefront search & product recommendations use case. High level: real-time search/autocomplete + reranking for product lists.

Volume context: peak 50k qps for autocomplete across regions, average 6M tokens/day, expect 3x during holiday window. Latency target is 20–50ms tail for autocomplete. Timeline: evaluating vendors this month; hoping to run a short pilot in early Oct.

Any chance to get a 30–40 minute demo early next week? Also — can you confirm whether Redwood has a recommended pattern for prefix caching + quantized models for lower-cost, high-throughput inference?

I attached a small traffic export (traffic-snapshot.csv) that summarizes our request distribution. Happy to share more.

Thanks,
Ari Patel
Head of Search Engineering, ClearMart
ari@clearmart.com
[Attachment: traffic-snapshot.csv]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Patel <ari@clearmart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — storefront search & throughput

Hi Ari — thanks for the note and for attaching the snapshot, that helps a lot. Quick follow-ups so we make the demo actionable: 

- Primary goal for the pilot: latency SLO validation, cost-per-query reduction, or quality/regression testing? (One primary, two secondary is fine)
- What fraction of traffic needs strict 20–50ms tail (e.g., top 10% vs 90%)?
- Do you plan to send queries as single-shot text or via streaming/partial-prefix updates from the UI?
- Any compliance needs (HIPAA/PHI, EU data residency) we should know before showing Private options?

If that looks right, I can book a 30-minute slot. Here are three windows (PST):
• Tue 2027-09-21 09:00–09:30
• Wed 2027-09-22 11:00–11:30
• Thu 2027-09-23 15:00–15:30

If none of those work, tell me a preferred window and timezone and we can be flexible. Ben — looped you in since ClearMart looks like a pilot fit for Dedicated capacity; can you take point on pricing & capacity questions if they surface?

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415-555-0192

On 2027-09-15 10:03, Mina Haddad wrote:
> Hi Ari — thanks for the note and for attaching the snapshot, that helps a lot. Quick follow-ups so we make the demo actionable:
>
> - Primary goal for the pilot: latency SLO validation, cost-per-query reduction, or quality/regression testing?
>
Thanks — primary goal is latency SLO validation and cost reduction; quality/regression is secondary.

Answers:
- Strict 20–50ms tail applies to the core autocomplete surface (roughly 40% of queries). Other endpoints can tolerate higher tail latency.
- We'll send single-shot queries from our frontend; there is some prefix update logic but we can simulate it in the demo.
- No special compliance constraints for this pilot; all data is standard product metadata. We'll want EU residency later, but not for the pilot.

The Tue 2027-09-21 09:00 PST slot works for us. Can you confirm a calendar invite + who will present? Also two quick asks:
1) Ben mentioned Dedicated capacity — can you share a ballpark monthly cost for a pilot sized for ~100k qps sustained?
2) Please include a short agenda and pre-demo checklist so our infra folks know what to prepare.

Thanks,
Ari
[--Sent from ClearMart office network]

Hi Ari — Ben here, sales engineering. Great to meet you virtually — we'll run the demo on Tue 2027-09-21 09:00–09:30 PST with Mina leading product flow and me covering deployment & cost. Calendar invite sent (you should have it).

Attached: demo-agenda.pdf (30m runbook), pre-demo-checklist.md (network IPs, sample payloads, auth tokens) — please share the network contact for your infra team so we can confirm connectivity checks prior to the session.

On the ballpark for Dedicated: for a pilot with ~100k qps headroom we typically start with a reserved pool sized around N GPU hosts (we'll tune after profiling). Ballpark monthly committed spend for pilot sizing is in the low-to-mid five figures — I'll follow up with a short one-pager with ranges once I review your snapshot more closely.

Looking forward — feel free to add any teammates to the invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
